containment.gloss: Decision-makers receive incomplete or contradictory warning before acting.
Authorities impose and revise measures to restrict movement or evacuate people as the emergency develops.
The measures fail in implementation, leaving people exposed or stranded.
After failure becomes visible, official records or public explanations minimize its scale or responsibility.

agricultural.gloss: An experimental agricultural or pesticide program is active before the outbreak.
Its development, handling, storage, or application fails outside intended controls.
Exposure travels beyond the immediate program work to a wider population.
The malfunction precedes and plausibly contributes to the outbreak without fixing a specific biological mechanism.
Public records or institutional explanations obscure the program's role once consequences appear.
